# Issue #301: remove the deprecated handler

registration so it no longer appears in `registry()`. Everything else must keep
working.

arguments.summary: Removed the deprecated `legacy_export` handler from `api/handlers.py` (explicitly marked "DEPRECATED since 1.2: replaced by export_v2") along with its entry in `_REGISTRY`, so it no longer appears in `registry()`. Kept `ping`, `export_v2`, and `stats` (whose comment is only an ambiguous "deprecated?" question) untouched. Verified the existing test suite passes and that `registry()`/`handle()` still work for the remaining handlers.
